_meta.note: Proper Vespers Aposticha verses for Menaion (non-Great) feasts, keyed M-D. Same shape as great-feast-variants.json apostichaVerses: indexed from the SECOND sticheron — the first carries no verse. Without an entry the assembler falls back to the ordinary Ps. 122 table. An entry may also set `apostichaGloryClaimsNow: true` when the Menaion doxastikon takes the "Now and ever" as well, so no separate Theotokion follows it.

apostichaVerses: Hearken, O daughter, and see, and incline thine ear!
Even the rich among the people shall pray before thy face.
10-1._source: OCA service text for October 1, reference/scrape/2024-10-01.docx (Ps. 44:9a, 44:11b); Tyler 10.01.26 packet sings the same verses.

11-8._source: Synaxis of the Archangels. reference/orders/2026-1108-order-services.txt line 39 reads "Glory... now and ever... Angels, Tone 8" -- ONE combined doxology over the single Tone 8 doxastikon, with no resurrectional Theotokion after it. The parish packet agrees: docs/11-7 Great Vespers/11.07.26 Great Vespers.pdf p.11 prints "Glory... Now and ever... (Tone 8)" as one label over "Since you, leader of hosts...", and strikes the Angels' Tone 1 stichera above it. Two independent oracles, which is why this is keyed per-date rather than inferred from rank: combinesGloryNow is otherwise true only for Great Feasts, and widening that globally would reshape every Menaion-glory day in the year. Found 2026-11-06 reviewing the packet.
